description: This file defines a composable screen for Android that handles connecting to a gateway, including UI elements for inputting setup codes, host, port, TLS options, and managing connection states. It also includes advanced controls for configuring connection parameters, displaying diagnostics, and handling gateway trust prompts.

classes.name: ConnectInputMode
classes.description: An enum class defining the input modes for the connection screen: SetupCode and Manual.

methods.name: ConnectTabScreen
methods.description: A composable function representing the main connection setup UI, managing various connection parameters, user inputs, and connection states.
